City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 01, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 11:44 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Anna Ma, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of January 25, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Sunbelt Rentals Inc., – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing rental of
  generators for the Police Department in the amount of $312.71. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Embassy Consulting Services, LLC. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing training in the Police Department in the amount of $3,200.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:50 a.m. Adjournment
